name: @true-utopian/vesper-antidetect-browser
description: Vesper Browser by true-utopian: independent local profiles, native kernel and optional Workbench add-on.
author: true-utopian

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/readme-status.mjs --check
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && node scripts/desktop-build.mjs browser win32
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/desktop-build.mjs browser linux --dir
